descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S06 「养老院服务端搜索：另一个医生的住户、搜索时的编辑和 + Today、删除」 Nursing Home server search: another physician's resident, edits and '+ Today' while searching, removal

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Owner A, a fresh @roundai.test physician, with 'QA Resident Find-<tok> One' (unit 'Rm 5', status pending, in Today's Visits), 'QA Resident Find-<tok> Two' (unit 'Rm 2', status pre-rounded, All Residents only) and 'QA Resident Unrelated' (unit 'Rm 1'). …

When As A, call snf:listPage for Today's Visits and for All Residents with search 'Find-<tok>' under each sort (room, name, status), two rows a page. Then, with the search still applied: rename One to 'QA Resident Renamed-<tok2>' and back; change One's unit to 'Rm 1'; change One's status pending → note-ready; …

Then Foreign is never returned in either view, under any sort or on any page; Unrelated is never returned. Each edit re-filters and re-sorts at once. The rename drops One and the rename back returns it. The unit change moves One before Two in All Residents room order. The status change moves One after Two in status order. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Returned ids per page, view and sort, compared with the expected id lists above (U4 isolation and re-filtering, U7 re-sorting). Diagnosis is left out on purpose so the verdict does not depend on AC 3. Tim's snf variant of the server-search API test is not reused: it asserts NH diagnosis search finds the resident, which AC 3 forbids. Needs precondition P1

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both (single-account legs) / local (Foreign leg) 跑；来源：newspec-a。

Detail:

P1 ready.
